brief: How do I make my site private?

candidates.note: A reference answer written by hand: there is no single private switch, so it picks the control by who should still get in, says hiding from search is not privacy, never asks for a password, and links the page it was given.
candidates.answer:
There isn't one private switch, so pick the setting by who should still see the site:

- **No one yet:** turn on **Maintenance mode** in **Admin → Error pages**. Every address shows your 503 page until you turn it off. Only a site admin can change it.
- **Anyone with the link, but not Google:** turn on **Discourage search engines** in **Setup → SEO**. This hides the site from search, but it does not stop people opening it.
- **Only people with a password:** set each page to **Password protected** in its **Page Access** card.
- **Only signed-in members:** set pages to **Members only** (Business plan and above).

See [Make your site private](https://docs.example.com/building-sites/site-protection/make-your-site-private) for the steps. I can also turn maintenance mode or the search switch on for you if you ask.

controls.why: A link to a page the answer was not grounded in.
controls.answer: Go to **Settings → Privacy** and switch the site to private. There is more in [this forum thread](https://random.example.net/private-site).
